The dataset contains 800 scenarios that test agent performance in environments where time flows continuously and events occur dynamically.
Gaia2 was created to address gaps in AI agent evaluation, specifically the lack of dynamic, time-aware, and multi-agent collaborative scenarios in existing benchmarks.
Gaia2 contains a single validation splits of 800 scenarios with oracle events for development and leaderboard submission (includes ground truth).
execution : Multi-step planning and state-changing operations (200 scenarios)
mini : Representative subset across all capabilities (200 scenarios)

with 160 scenarios per core capability (Execution, Search, Adaptability, Time, Ambiguity) and a representative sample of each capability's scenarios for augmentation capabilities (Agent2Agent, App/Environment Noise)
Each scenario underwent validation by multiple independent annotators.
